2607.26594.title: A Physics-Informed Framework for PID Tuning of Chemical Processes Using Large Language Model Agents
2607.26594.paper_summary: PID tuning for chemical processes commonly relies on identified process models, whereas plant engineers often retune loops iteratively by observing responses, diagnosing deficiencies, adjusting gains, and validating the result. This work formalizes this engineer-like workflow in a language-model-assisted PID tuning framework applicable to both large and small language models (LLMs/SLMs). Hosted LLMs receive closed-loop response features, control-engineering diagnoses, tuning preferences, and internal model control (IMC)-based demonstrations to generate and iteratively correct PID gains under common acceptance criteria. For local deployment, Qwen3-0.6B is adapted through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with simulation-verified IMC targets and physics-informed group relative policy optimization (PI-GRPO) with non-compensable stability and performance rewards. On 100 first-order plus dead time (FOPDT) and 100 second-order plus dead time (SOPDT) test cases, hosted LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen3.7-Plus) achieve final success rates of 75-89% and 77-79%, respectively. As for Qwen3-0.6B, supervised fine-tuning raises first-recommendation success to 86.5%, and PI-GRPO further increases it to 94.0%, primarily improving first-attempt reliability and stability margins.
2607.26594.paper_summary_zh: PID 調整在化學過程中通常依賴於已識別的過程模型，而工廠工程師則經常通過觀察反應、診斷不足、調整增益和驗證結果來迭代調整迴路。這項工作將這種工程師式的工作流程形式化為一種語言模型輔助的 PID 調整框架，適用於大型和小型語言模型 (LLMs/SLMs)。託管的 LLM 接收閉環反應特徵、控制工程診斷、調整偏好和基於內部模型控制 (IMC) 的演示，以生成並在常見接受標準下迭代修正 PID 增益。對於本地部署，Qwen3-0.6B 通過監督微調 (SFT) 進行調整，使用模擬驗證的 IMC 目標和物理知識驅動的群體相對政策優化 (PI-GRPO)，並考慮不可補償的穩定性和性能獎勵。在 100 個一階加死時間 (FOPDT) 和 100 個二階加死時間 (SOPDT) 測試案例中，託管的 LLM (DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 Qwen3.7-Plus) 的最終成功率分別達到 75-89% 和 77-79%。至於 Qwen3-0.6B，監督微調將第一次推薦的成功率提高至 86.5%，而 PI-GRPO 進一步將其提高至 94.0%，主要改善了第一次嘗試的可靠性和穩定性邊際。
